title: Clinical outcomes of the PAUL glaucoma implant in primary open-angle and pseudoexfoliative glaucoma eyes after failed glaucoma surgeries
indication: refractory glaucoma after failed previous glaucoma surgery (all eyes: trabeculectomy, cyclophotocoagulation, XEN, canaloplasty, Trabectome, PreserFlo, deep sclerectomy, iStent, needling), subgroups primary open-angle glaucoma (POAG) and pseudoexfoliative glaucoma (PEXG); Caucasian patients; retrospective cohort from a prospectively collected database (Bonn, Germany)

groups.description: POAG eyes receiving the PAUL glaucoma implant (superotemporal plate, MMC 0.5 mg/mL for 2 min, 6-0 polypropylene intraluminal stent, double-layered patch graft); n from Table 1 (tbl-0001!R9C2) and Table 6 gender counts
PEXG eyes receiving the PAUL glaucoma implant (same technique); n from Table 1 (tbl-0001!R10C2) and Table 6 gender counts

exclusions.reason: whole cohort duplicates the POAG and PEXG subgroups tabulated in Table 6 (brief rule: extract subgroups, not the whole cohort)
historical maximum, not the preoperative reference IOP
absolute IOP is available; whole-cohort series not used

exclusions.what: Table 6 / Table 3 numbers of IOP-lowering drops
exclusions.reason: medication numbers are not IOP series in schema 1.0.0; noted only

exclusions.what: complete and qualified success rates (Figure 1, text) and Kaplan-Meier analyses
exclusions.reason: success proportions / Kaplan-Meier estimates are not admissible

exclusions.what: Table 4 complications, Table 5 additional glaucoma surgeries, Table 6 complication/revision/failure counts
IOP before and after intraluminal stent removal (text, 10 eyes)
exclusions.reason: analysis set selected by a postoperative event and reported in text only, not in a timed table

notes: Reference kind 'preoperative_medicated': all patients were using topical IOP-lowering therapy preoperatively (Table 1 'Number of glaucoma drops', 22.9% also on acetazolamide).
Subgroup sizes: Table 1 and the Table 6 gender counts give 29 POAG and 19 PEXG eyes; one Results sentence states the reverse (typographical inconsistency in the text).
Day 1 and Week 1 converted as 1/30.4375 and 7/30.4375 months (rounded to 4 decimals).

Per-visit numbers are not reported; the whole-cohort Table 2 means and the subgroup Table 6 means are not exactly reconcilable with the subgroup sizes at every visit, which suggests varying per-visit numbers.

The polypropylene intraluminal stent was removed during follow-up in 10 eyes when IOP exceeded target (standard postoperative care of this technique); the PGI is a standard drainage device in this cohort, so the subgroups are 'control' groups.

series.notes: cells are 'mean (range)' (the Results text quotes these subgroup values as mean IOP); rows Preoperative, Day 1, Week 1, Month 1, Month 3, Month 6, Month 12; per-visit n not reported; Table 6 R41 reports failure due to additional glaucoma surgery (PGI explantation) in 2 POAG eyes, and the article does not state whether their later IOP was censored

cells are 'mean (range)'; rows Preoperative, Day 1, Week 1, Month 1, Month 3, Month 6, Month 12; per-visit n not reported; Table 6 R41 reports failure due to additional glaucoma surgery in 1 PEXG eye, censoring not stated
